children: China's AI application names, which include large language model players and humanoid robot companies, have long-term potential, but face near-term challenges, according to BofA Securities in a research note. "Intense competition are already pressuring pricing and margins in segments such as large language models and humanoid robotics," BofA says. They also lack a clear killer product, which is capable of driving mass adoption and sustainable profits, the bank says. Therefore, investors are "generally more cautious" on these stocks given the near-term monetization uncertainty and execution risks, it adds. (tracy.qu@wsj.com)
